content:
What's the process for adding the documentation for a plugin to the online manual?
It seems to be a bit of a catch-22
A developer builds a plugin, but until the documentation is somehow added to the manual, the developer does not know the url for their plugin's documentation, so cannot provide the information for the plugin's metadata.
Are we meant to clone https://github.com/opencpn-manuals, add our changes to site.yml and submit a PR ?
